observations.behavior: Adds a test asserting that the TOTP-related error is classified as non-retryable.
observations.posthog_connection: This could help prevent automated warehouse syncs from repeatedly retrying a connection that requires a live TOTP passcode, which an unattended process cannot provide. This could reduce unnecessary API calls and account lockouts. However, without the connector implementation, it is not established whether the connector actually detects this error or acts on this message.
